summary: No actionable correctness blocker in asynchronous decoupled speculative zswap prefetch. Synchronously loading only the demanded order-0 folio via swap_cache_read_folio_sync completely eliminates the +280% synchronous zswap decompression latency burst in the fault path. Dispatching speculative neighboring swap slots to a background workqueue (zswap_prefetch_wq) using non-blocking allocation (GFP_NOWAIT) and zswap_load preserves speculative cache warming without blocking user threads. Lifetime management via get_swap_device and folio_put is fully sound.
